name: Lotte Pitcher
role: Head of Developer Relations at Umbraco
bio: Lotte Pitcher has been building websites with Microsoft technologies for longer than she cares to remember. After running her own agency in London, she now heads up the Developer Relations team at Umbraco, where she helps maintain the open-source .NET CMS and the wonderfully friendly global community that has grown up around it. She is a keen organiser of meetups, hackathons and conferences, and a passionate advocate for open, welcoming tech communities.
